name: hyperlocal-emergency-platform
description: A real-time emergency coordination platform connecting citizens to nearby eligible responders (Ambulance, Police, Fire) with GPS pinpointing, speech translation, OSRM routing, live status progression, and offline zero-network emergency contact access.

scripts.dev: concurrently "node server/index.js" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
